name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_parkinson_s_disease_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of Parkinson's disease.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a diagnosis of Parkinson's disease.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a diagnosis of Parkinson's disease.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of Parkinson's disease.

name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_parkinson_s_disease_now@@diagnosed_by_united_kingdom_brain_bank_criteria
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's current diagnosis of Parkinson's disease is determined by the United Kingdom Brain Bank (UKBB) criteria.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's current diagnosis of Parkinson's disease is determined by the United Kingdom Brain Bank (UKBB) criteria.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's current diagnosis of Parkinson's disease is not determined by the United Kingdom Brain Bank (UKBB) criteria.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient's current diagnosis of Parkinson's disease is determined by the United Kingdom Brain Bank (UKBB) criteria.

name: patient_has_history_of_exposure_to_dopaminergic_neurotoxin
